title: Katherine Hsiao / WEF Data Policy council depth 6
summary: WEF directly documents Katherine Hsiao's prior service on its Global Future Council for Data Policy. The council produced policy-oriented work on digital justice in 2021, but this pass does not attribute authorship or endorsement of that white paper to Hsiao without a member/contributor record tying her to the output.

gaps: Exact start and end dates of Hsiao's council term remain unresolved.
A direct council roster or publication contributor list tying Hsiao to Pathways to Digital Justice was not retrieved.
The WEF-hosted PDF timed out during direct retrieval in this pass.
caveats: Council service does not establish authorship, agreement with every council output, or downstream policy adoption.

data.question: What official WEF records resolve Katherine Hsiao's Global Future Council for Data Policy role and its outputs?
data.method: Review of WEF person profile, publication metadata and white-paper launch materials.
data.scope: Council role, council-level outputs and attribution boundaries.
findings: WEF's Katherine Hsiao profile explicitly states that she served on the Global Future Council for Data Policy.

WEF published Pathways to Digital Justice on September 29, 2021 and states that the Global Future Council on Data Policy worked with two other Global Future Councils and an advisory committee on the policy framework.
The publication sought to guide policy efforts addressing data-driven harms and digital redress mechanisms.
The white-paper launch names speakers including JoAnn Stonier and other experts, but the indexed launch page does not name Katherine Hsiao.
conclusions: A direct Hsiao-to-council relationship is verified; a Hsiao-to-specific-white-paper authorship/contribution relation remains unverified.
limitations: The source PDF could not be fetched to inspect contributor pages directly.
unresolved: Whether Hsiao is listed in the white-paper contributor/advisory pages
